title: 何小姐

series.next: Every Saturday for six years. Then the lawyer from 深圳 calls.

setting: The old villa on the hill above the village, Saturday, 2 pm. A rich woman has asked for a child to keep her company.

steps.narr: Some nights you still dream of the chain on the mudflats.

else.narr: Some nights you wonder if he's still alive.

steps.zh: 何小姐要一个孩子去陪她。你去。
steps.en: Miss He wants a child to keep her company. You're going.

steps.narr: The villa on the hill. Every clock in the house says 9:15.
She is wearing a wedding dress, yellow with age. On the long table, a cake under dust.

steps.en: Come here. Let me look at you.

say.gloss: Good afternoon, Miss He. I'm sorry to intrude.
say.tip: 小姐 xiǎojiě = Miss: old-fashioned, and here exactly right.

answers: 何小姐好，冒昧打扰，请多关照。
何小姐您好，冒昧打扰了，请多关照。
4.gloss: Good afternoon, Miss He. Forgive the intrusion. I hope you'll be patient with me.
4.tip: 冒昧 màomèi = presumptuous: 冒昧打扰, the formal sorry-to-intrude.

answers: 会一点，不过下得不太好。
say.tip: 下棋 xiàqí = play chess. 下得不太好 = don't play very well.

answers: 会一点，下得不好，您多包涵。
会一点，下得不好，请您多包涵。
4.gloss: A little, and badly. Please forgive me in advance.
4.tip: 包涵 bāohán = bear with, forgive.

steps.narr: You play. You lose. 小雪 doesn't look up once.

say.en: Stand up for yourself: you didn't come here to be laughed at.
say.gloss: I didn't come here for you to laugh at.
say.tip: 我不是来……的 = I didn't come to ...

ok.narr: 小雪 looks at you for the first time.

answers: 我来下棋，不是来让你笑话的。
我是来下棋的，不是来让你笑话的。
4.gloss: I came to play chess, not to be laughed at.
4.tip: 笑话 xiàohua = laugh at, make fun of.

steps.narr: 小雪 goes. 何小姐 beckons you closer.

steps.en: She'll break your heart, you know.
Next week. Will you come again?

say.en: Say you'll come back next week, or that you won't come again.
say.tip: 还来 = come again: 还 = still, once more.

ok.narr: At the gate, 小雪 pushes something into your hand without a word: a chess piece. The general.

then.narr: At the gate, you look back. 小雪 is watching from an upstairs window.

answers: 下周还来，再跟小雪下一盘。
下周我还来，再跟小雪下一盘。
4.gloss: I'll come next week, and play 小雪 again.

answers: 谢谢何小姐，我以后不来了。
alts.gloss: Thank you, Miss He. I won't be coming again.

steps.en: Every Saturday after that, the clocks still say 9:15, and you lose at chess a little less. ♟️

else.en: You never go back. But every evening at 9:15, you look at the clock. 🕰️
